reason: This Hebrew text from Exodus 17 describes the battle between Israel and Amalek at Rephidim. The passage recounts how Moses raised his staff while Joshua fought against Amalek, how Aaron and Hur supported Moses' arms, and how Yahweh promised to blot out the memory of Amalek from heaven. There is no mention of Yahweh threatening to kill the Hebrews or Israelites, nor any reference to proper or improper worship as a condition for their survival. The text depicts Yahweh as actively assisting Israel in battle against their enemies, not threatening the Israelites themselves.
